advanced-filter-description: Isihluzi esikwinqanaba eliphambili livumela ukubhala umtya oqulathe abaqhubi abalandelayo: == != <= >= && || () Isithuba sisetyenziswa njengomahluli phakathi kwabaSebenzisi. Unokuzihluza zonke iiNdawo eziSiko ngokuchwetheza amagama kunye namaxabiso azo. Umzekelo: Ummandla1 == Ixabiso1. Qaphela: Ukuba amasimi okanye amaxabiso aqulathe izithuba, kufuneka uwahlanganisele kucatshulo olunye. Umzekelo: 'Ummandla 1' == 'Ixabiso loku-1'. Ukufumana abasebenzi bolawulo olunye (' \/) ukuba batsibe, ungasebenzisa \. Umzekelo: Indawo1 == Ndim. Kwakhona unokudibanisa iimeko ezininzi. Umzekelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngokwesiqhelo bonke abasebenzi batolikwa ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene. Unokutshintsha iodolo ngokubeka izibiyeli. Umzekelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3). Kananjalo unokukhangela iindawo ezibhaliweyo usebenzisa i-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

email-recovery-description: Umgca omnye ngomamkeli ngamnye. Khangela nge-ID yomsebenzisi. Umxholo womyalezo namacandelo e-imeyile omamkeli awaboniswa. Ukunqumama kubamba imiyalezo ekhoyo nezayo; Ukuqhubeka kuzama kwakhona ukuthumela imiyalezo esemgceni ngoku. Ukurhoxisa kususa imiyalezo efakwe emgceni ukuya kwixesha lesicelo. Ukuba ukuthumela kuxakekile, zama kwakhona emva komzuzwana. Umyalezo osele uqalisile ukuthunyelwa awunakubuyiswa, kwaye ukuthumela okunesiphumo esingaqinisekanga kunokuphindwa. Ukusilela okusisigxina nemiyalezo efikelele kumda wokuzama kwakhona kuhlala kukhona ukuze kuhlolwe. Ukuzama kwakhona imiyalezo engaphumelelanga kuqalisa umjikelo omtsha wemizamo kwaye kugcina ukunqumama okukhoyo.
email-recovery-empty: Akukho miyalezo emgceni kwaye akukho bamkeli kunqunyanyiswe ukuthumela kubo.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Hlaziya umgca uze uzame kwakhona isenzo esifanayo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
email-recovery-superseded: Isenzo esitsha somsebenzisi olawulayo sithathe indawo yesi sicelo. Kuboniswa imeko yangoku yomgca.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazeki ukufunda umgca wee-imeyile. Jonga amalungelo omlawuli nokufumaneka kweseva.

error-json-schema: Idatha yakho ye-JSON ayibandakanyi ulwazi olufanelekileyo kwifomethi echanekileyo
error-user-notSameOrgOrTeam: Ungongeza kuphela abasebenzisi abavela kuMbutho okanye iQela elinye
filter-on-desc: Uhluza amakhadi kule bhodi. Cofa apha ukuhlela isihluzo.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Ukuthumela ngaphandle kuchaza amagama eziqhoboshelo zako kodwa akuphathi iifayile. Ukuze uzizise, nika idilesi yenkonzo nokungena: zisetyenziswa kolu ngeniso kuphela, zithunyelwa kuloo dilesi kuphela, kwaye azize zigcinwe. Shiya kungenanto ukuze ungenise ngaphandle kweefayile.
import-attachment-auth-token: Ithokheni ye-API, isitshixo se-API okanye inombolo yokuvula ye-app
import-board-instruction-asana: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yokukhutshwa kwe-tasks ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } evela kukukhutshwa kwe-Asana okanye GET /tasks). Ii-tasks zihlelwa ngokwamacandelo (memberships); ii-tasks ezigqityiweyo ziya ku-Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Kwi-Businessmap (eyayisakuba yi-Kanbanize), vula Advanced Search, khetha Configure results ukukhetha iikholam, khuphela ifayile ye-Excel, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Iikholam zifundwa ngamagama azo esiNgesi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ukuba iakhawunti yakho isebenzisa olunye ulwimi, qala uthiye umqolo wezihloko ngesiNgesi. Column iba zizintlu kwaye Lane iba ziindlela zokuqubha; abanini, iithegi, umbala, imihla, izimvo namakhonkco abazali zigcina iindawo zazo, kwaye Priority, Size, Type nezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Kwi-ClickUp, thumela imisebenzi ngaphandle njenge-CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, okanye ukuthumela ngaphandle kumboniso we-List okanye we-Table nazo zonke iikholam), emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu, izintlu ze-ClickUp ziba ziindlela zokuqubha, kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi kunye nemisebenzi engaphantsi, ababelweyo, iithegi, imihla, izinto eziphambili nexesha.
import-board-instruction-csv: Ncamathelisa iComma Separated Values(CSV)/Tab yakho eyahluliweyo amaxabiso (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-deck: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yebhodi ye-NextCloud Deck (ibhodi ene-"stacks", i-stack nganye iphethe "cards" zayo). Ii-stacks ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-cards ziba ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetha i-spreadsheet ye-.xlsx yohlobo lwe-WeKan (iikholam ezifanayo nezokukhutshwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, imihla, iindawo zesiko). Umqolo wokuqala ngumbhalo-ntloko.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khupha ifayile ye-.boardarchive kwindawo ecinezelweyo uze uncamathisele umxholo we-board.jsonl yebhodi, kunye nomgca wenguqulelo okanye ngaphandle kwawo. Uphawu lokwahlula ngokwamaqela kumboniso webhodi luba zizintlu, ezinye iimpawu zokukhetha ziba ziileyibhile, iibhloko zombhalo neebhokisi zokukhangela ziba yinkcazelo noluhlu lokukhangela, aze amagqabantshintshi agcinwe. Imifanekiso nezincamatheliso azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-issues: Ncamathelisa i-array ye-JSON ye-issues ye-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ii-issues ziba ngamakhadi ahlelwe kwizintlu ezithi Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Ncamathelisa i-JSON ekhutshelwe ngaphandle ye-Kanboard: into ene-"columns" (okanye ii-tasks eziphethe i-column_name) kunye ne-array ye-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Ii-columns ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-tasks ziba ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kwi-Kanri, vula Import & Export uze ukhethe Export individual board (okanye Export all data), emva koko uncamathisele ifayile ye-.json. Iikholam ziba zizintlu kwaye amakhadi aba ngamakhadi, kunye nenkcazo, umhla wokugqibela, iithegi nemibala; imisebenzi yekhadi iba luluhlu lokuhlola. Ekuthunyelweni ngaphandle kwedatha yonke kungeniswa ibhodi yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-leo: Ncamathisela isakhiwo se-Leo (ifayile ye-.leo). Amacandelo akwinqanaba eliphezulu aba zizintlu, amacandelo angaphantsi kwawo ngokuthe ngqo aba ngamakhadi, ze umbhalo wecandelo ube yinkcazo yekhadi. Amacandelo akumanqanaba anzulu aba zizintlu zokukhangela. Amacandelo aphawuliweyo angeniswa njengagqityiweyo.
import-board-instruction-linear: Kwi-Linear, thumela imiba ngaphandle njenge-CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, okanye ukuthumela ngaphandle kumboniso), emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu, amaqela aba ziindlela zokuqubha, kwaye imiba iba ngamakhadi kunye nomntu owabelweyo, iileyibhile, imihla, umba ongumzali, into ephambili, uqikelelo, iprojekthi nomjikelo.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Ncamathisela uluhlu lwemisebenzi lwe-markdown (indlela ezisetyenziswa zizixhobo ze-markdown-kanban ezifana ne-Obsidian Kanban): izihloko ze-"## Igama loluhlu", nezinto ze- "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngezantsi. Izihloko ziba luluhlu, ezinto zibe amakhadi.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Kwi-MeisterTask, cofa igama leprojekthi, khetha Export project uze uthumele ngaphandle i-CSV, emva koko uyincamathisele. Amacandelo aba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye namanqaku, umhla wokugqibela, umntu owabelweyo neethegi; imisebenzi egqityiweyo igcina umhla wayo wokugqitywa. I-CSV ebhalelwe ukungenisa kwe-MeisterTask ngokwayo nayo iyasebenza.
import-board-instruction-monday: Kwi-monday.com, vula imenyu yebhodi, khetha More actions kunye Export board to Excel (kunye nohlaziyo nezinto ezingaphantsi ukuba uyafuna), emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Ikholam ye-Status iba zizintlu kwaye amaqela aba ziindlela zokuqubha; abantu, imihla, umgca wexesha neethegi zigcina iindawo zazo, ezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena kwaye uhlaziyo luba zizimvo.
import-board-instruction-notion: Kwi-Notion, vula uvimba wedatha njengephepha elipheleleyo, khetha ••• kunye Export, khetha Markdown & CSV, uze ukhethe ifayile ye-.zip ekhutshelwayo, okanye i-CSV enye yovimba wedatha engaphakathi kuyo, okanye uncamathisele loo CSV. Ikholam ebizwa Status iba zizintlu (xa ingekho, kusetyenziswa ikholam yokuqala ebonakala ilukhetho, kwaye ingxelo yokungenisa ichaza ukuba yeyiphi); imiqolo iba ngamakhadi kunye nesihloko, iithegi njengeeleyibhile, abantu njengamalungu, imihla, nombhalo wephepha njengenkcazo; ezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena. Ubudlelwane, imifanekiso nezincamathelisi azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Kwi-Nullboard, vula ibhodi, khetha Export this board... kwimenyu, vula ifayile ye-.nbx kumhleli wombhalo uze uncamathisele okuqulethwe yiyo. Izintlu ziba zizintlu kwaye amanqaku aba ngamakhadi: umgca wokuqala wenqaku uba sisihloko sekhadi kwaye okuseleyo kuba yinkcazo yalo. Inqaku elikuhlobo lwe-raw lifumana ileyibhile ethi raw. Kwifayile eneebhodi ezininzi kungeniswa ibhodi yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Kwi-Obsidian, vula ifayile yebhodi ye-Kanban njenge-Markdown (okanye uvule ifayile ye-.md kumhleli wombhalo), emva koko uncamathisele yonke. Iindlela ziba zizintlu kunye nemida yazo yamakhadi, amakhadi agcina iithegi, imihla, izinto eziphambili, iinkalo noluhlu lokuhlola, kwaye i-Archive iba ngamakhadi agcinwe kwindawo yogcino.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yeqoqo le-work-packages ye-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Ii-statuses ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-work packages ziba ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Ncamathisela ulwandlalo lwe-OPML oluthunyelwe ngaphandle yi-Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq okanye ezinye iinkqubo zolwandlalo. Izinto ezikwinqanaba eliphezulu ziba zizintlu, eziphantsi kwazo ziba ngamakhadi anenqaku njengenkcazo, kwaye ezikumanqanaba anzulu ziba zizintlu zokuhlola. Izinto ezigqityiweyo zingeniswa njengezigqityiweyo.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Ncamathisela ifayile ye-Org mode ebhalwe yi-Emacs, Orgzly okanye Beorg. Izihloko ezikwinqanaba eliphezulu ziba zizintlu kwaye izihloko zenqanaba lesibini ziba ngamakhadi. TODO kunye DONE, izinto eziphambili, iithegi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE kunye CLOSED ziyagcinwa, kwaye iibhokisi zokukhangela nezihloko ezinzulu ziba zizintlu zokuhlola.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Kwi-Pivotal Tracker, vula ithebhu ye-MORE yeprojekthi uze ukhethe Export CSV (okanye ukhethe amabali uze ukhethe Bulk Actions, CSV), emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Imeko nganye yebali iba luluhlu kwaye amabali aba ngamakhadi, kunye nohlobo neeleyibhile zawo, abanini, umceli, imihla, izimvo, imisebenzi nezithintelo; Estimate iba yi-Story points kwaye uphindaphindo luba zii-sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: Kwi-Plane, vula Workspace Settings, khetha Exports, thumela iiprojekthi ngaphandle njenge-JSON, CSV okanye Excel uze ukhuphele ifayile ye-.zip, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile, okanye ifayile enye engaphakathi kuyo, okanye uncamathisele i-JSON okanye i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu, iiprojekthi ziba ziindlela zokuqubha, kwaye imiba iba ngamakhadi kunye nesazisi, umzali, ababelweyo, iileyibhile, imihla, amakhonkco nezimvo; into ephambili, uqikelelo, umjikelo nemodyuli ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena. Ukuthumela ngaphandle kwe-Plane akunazo iinkcazo okanye izincamathelisi, ngoko azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-planner: Kwi-Microsoft Planner, vula imenyu yesicwangciso uze ukhethe Export plan to Excel, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Amaqela aba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye nababelweyo, imihla, iileyibhile, uluhlu lokuhlola nenkcazo; Progress, Priority kunye Completed By ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-quire: Kwi-Quire, vula imenyu yeprojekthi uze ukhethe Export CSV, emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. Iimeko ziba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye nemisebenzi engaphantsi njengamakhadi angaphantsi, ababelweyo, iithegi njengeeleyibhile, imihla yokuqala, yokugqibela neyokugqitywa, inkcazo nento ephambili njengenkalo eyenzelwe wena. Izimvo nezincamathelisi azikho kwi-CSV ye-Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Kwi-Redmine, vula Issues yeprojekthi, khetha Also available in: CSV emazantsi oluhlu, khetha iikholam (All columns, kunye Description) uze uthumele ngaphandle, emva koko uncamathisele i-CSV. I-Redmine ithiya iikholam ngolwimi lwakho, ngoko seta ulwimi lwakho lube sisiNgesi kwi-My account ngaphambi kokuthumela ngaphandle. Imeko nganye iba luluhlu kwaye imiba iba ngamakhadi, kunye nesilandeleli njengeleyibhile, umntu owabelweyo, umbhali, imihla, umsebenzi ongumzali nemiba enxulumeneyo; into ephambili, udidi, uhlobo ekujoliswe kulo, ixesha eliqikelelweyo, % Done neenkalo ezenzelwe wena ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Kwi-Super Productivity, vula Settings, emva koko Sync & Backup, khetha Export Data uze uncamathisele okuqulethwe yifayile ye-sp-backup .json. Iprojekthi nganye iba yindlela yokuqubha kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi kwi-To Do, In Progress, Backlog okanye Done, kunye namanqaku, iithegi, umhla wokugqibela, ixesha elichithiweyo nemisebenzi engaphantsi; imisebenzi egcinwe kwindawo yogcino iba ngamakhadi agcinwe kwindawo yogcino.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Kwi-Taiga, vula Admin > Project > Export uze ukhuphele idatha yeprojekthi (qala ukhulule ifayile ye-.json.gz), emva koko uncamathisele i-JSON yayo. Iimeko zamabali abasebenzisi ziba zizintlu, amabali abasebenzisi aba ngamakhadi nemisebenzi yawo ibe yimisebenzi engaphantsi, ii-epic nemiba zifumana iindlela zokuqubha zazo, kwaye ii-sprint, iithegi, izimvo neempawu ezenzelwe wena nazo ziyangeniswa. Izincamathelisi azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Kwi-Tasks.org, vula Settings, Backups uze ukhethe Export tasks, emva koko uncamathisele okuqulethwe yile fayile ye-.json. Izintlu ziba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye namanqaku, iithegi, imihla, izimvo nemisebenzi engaphantsi; imisebenzi egqityiweyo igcina umhla wayo wokugqitywa, kwaye into ephambili iba yinkalo eyenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ncamathisela isiphumo se-task export: uluhlu lwe-JSON okanye umsebenzi omnye kumgca ngamnye. Imisebenzi egqityiweyo iya ku-Done, i-project ne-priority ziba ziileyibhile, i-annotations iba ngamagqabantshintshi, kanti i-depends iba kukuxhomekeka kwimisebenzi ethintelayo.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Kwi-Teamwork.com, gcwalisa itemplate yokungenisa imisebenzi ye-Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) uze uyigcine njenge-.xlsx, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile. Izintlu zemisebenzi ziba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi; umsebenzi oqala ngo -, # okanye > uba ngumsebenzi ongaphantsi komsebenzi ongasentla kwawo (--, ## okanye >> kwinqanaba elinye elinzulu). Ababelweyo, imihla neethegi zigcina iindawo zazo; Priority, Estimated time kunye Complete ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Kwi-TickTick, vula Settings, Account, Backup & Import uze wenze ikopi yokugcina, emva koko uncamathisele ifayile ye-CSV. Uluhlu ngalunye lwe-TickTick luba yindlela yokuqubha kwaye iikholam zalo ziba zizintlu; imisebenzi igcina iithegi, imihla, uluhlu lokuhlola, izinto eziphambili nemisebenzi engaphantsi.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Kwi-Todoist, vula imenyu yeprojekthi uze ukhethe Export as a template, emva koko uncamathisele ifayile ye-CSV. Amacandelo aba zizintlu, imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, imisebenzi engaphantsi iba luluhlu lokuhlola, amanqaku aba zizimvo, kwaye @labels nezinto eziphambili p1 ukuya p3 ziba ziileyibhile.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Cola ifayile ye-todo.txt: umsebenzi omnye kumgca ngamnye, ngendlela i-app ye-todo.txt nee-app ezihambelanayo eziyibhala ngayo. Imisebenzi egqityiweyo ("x") iya kwicandelo eligqityiweyo, +project no-@context ziba ziilebhile, (A) iba yilebhile yokubaluleka, kanti due: no-t: ziba yimihla yokugqibela neyokuqala.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Kwi-Vikunja, vula Settings, khetha Data Export uze ukhuphele ifayile ye-.zip ethunyelwa kuwe, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile, okanye uncamathisele i-data.json engaphakathi kuyo. Amaqela e-Kanban aba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye neeleyibhile, ababelweyo, imihla, inkcazo, izintlu zemisebenzi njengezintlu zokuhlola nezimvo; into ephambili, ipesenti egqityiweyo nokugqitywa ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena. Izincamathelisi azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Kwi-Wrike, thumela iprojekthi okanye isiqulathi seefayile ngaphandle kwi-Excel, okanye ugcwalise itemplate yokungenisa ye-Excel ye-Wrike, emva koko ukhethe loo fayile ye-.xlsx. Imiqolo yezisiqulathi zeefayile neeprojekthi iba ziindlela zokuqubha, Status iba zizintlu kwaye imisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, kunye ne-Key, umsebenzi ongumzali, ababelweyo, imihla yokuqala neyokuphela, izinto exhomekeke kuzo nenkcazo; Priority, Duration nezinye iikholam ziba ziinkalo ezenzelwe wena.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Ncamathelisa i-JSON yokukhutshwa koluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Ii-stages ziba zizintlu kwaye ii-items ziba ngamakhadi.
import-file-label: Khetha ifayile ethunyelwe ngaphandle, okanye ucole umbhalo wayo ngezantsi:
import-members-map: Ibhodi yakho evela kumazwe angaphandle inamalungu athile. Nceda imephu amalungu ofuna ukungenisa kubasebenzisi bakho
import-members-map-note: Qaphela: Amalungu angafakwanga kwimaphu aya kwabelwa kumsebenzisi wangoku.
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bagcine njengabasebenzisi ababambe indawo abanamagama abo, ukuze badityaniswe nabasebenzisi bokwenene kamva
import-not-wekan-export: Loo fayile ayilofayile ethunyelwe ngaphandle ye-WeKan
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Umzila wokuqubha ngamnye obuya kwenziwa kukungenisa (iprojekthi, ifolda okanye uluhlu lwesixhobo) uba yibhodi yawo. Amakhadi angabazali nezinto ezixhomekeke kwezinye phakathi kwezi bhodi zidweliswa kwingxelo yokungenisa.
import-report-description: Ibhodi yenziwe, kodwa ezinye iinxalenye zefayile azikwazanga ukudluliselwa. Ingxelo efanayo igcinwe ku-Iphaneli yoLawulo → Iingxaki → Ukubuyisela.
import-too-large: Ifayile inkulu kakhulu ukuba ingeniswe kanye. Yahlule ibe ziifayile ezincinci, umzekelo ngeprojekthi okanye ngomhla, uze ungenise nganye nganye.
instance-desc: Wonke umsebenzisi ongenileyo kule WeKan unokulibona eli bhodi. Alize liboniswe kubantu abangangenanga. Ngabantu abongezwe ebhodini kuphela abanokulihlela.
invalid-file: Ukuba igama lefayile alisebenzi, ukulayisha okanye ukuthiya ngokutsha kuyarhoxiswa.
invalid-year: Unyaka ongasebenziyo. Chwetheza onke amanani amane, umzekelo 2026.
list-permissions-desc: Oko indima nganye enokukwenza kolu luhlu, ngaphezu koko ibhodi ikuvumelayo. Abalawuli bebhodi banokuhlela rhoqo.
muted-info: Awusoze waziswe ngalo naluphi na utshintsho kule bhodi
name: Igama
notification-delivery-layout-clear: Kulungelelaniswe ngokucacileyo: ibhodi, umntu, nekhadi ngombhalo ongqindilili
password-change-required-text: Le sayithi ngoku ifuna iiphasiwedi ezinoonobumba abangama-__min__ ubuncinane, kwaye eyakho imfutshane. Khetha ende ukuze uqhubeke. Emva koko zonke iiseshoni ze-akhawunti yakho ziyaphuma, kwaye ungena kwakhona ngephasiwedi entsha.
password-length-from-environment: Ixabiso elisetwe kwimeko-bume yeseva liyasebenza; ukugcina apha kuyalitshintsha.
password-length-report-desc: Ii-akhawunti ezingene ngephasiwedi emfutshane kunobude obuncinane. Sisikhangeli kuphela esaziyo ukuba iphasiwedi inde kangakanani, ngoko sixela emfutshane emva kokungena; iphasiwedi nobude bayo azize ziphume kuso. Ilungisiwe lixesha apho iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yatshintshwayo - i-akhawunti engena kwakhona ngephasiwedi emfutshane iboniswa njengemfutshane kakhulu kwakhona.
password-min-length-description: Ukungena ngephasiwedi emfutshane kudweliswe ngezantsi. Ukungena akuze kwaliwe ngenxa yoko.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Iphasiwedi entsha emfutshane iyaliwa, kwaye i-akhawunti engena ngephasiwedi emfutshane kufuneka iyitshintshe phambi kwayo nantoni na enye. Ukuyitshintsha kuphuma kuzo zonke iiseshoni ze-akhawunti. Iiphasiwedi ze-LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS kunye neSandstorm zezababoneleli bazo, kwaye azijongwa.
password-pwned: Le nombolo yokuvula ivelile kukuvuza kwedatha. Khetha enye.
password-same-as-username: Inombolo yokuvula mayingabi ligama lomsebenzisi okanye idilesi yemeyile.
password-too-short: Inombolo yokuvula kufuneka ibe noonobumba abangama-__min__ ubuncinane.
preview-pdf-not-supported: Isixhobo sakho asikuxhasi ukujonga kwangaphambili iPDF. Zama ukukhuphela endaweni yoko.
private-desc: Le bhodi ibucala. Ngabantu abongezwe kwibhodi kuphela abanokuyijonga kwaye bayihlele.
public-desc: Le bhodi isesidlangalaleni. Ibonakala kuye nabani na onekhonkco kwaye iya kuvela kwiinjini zokukhangela ezifana noGoogle. Ngabantu abongezwe kwibhodi kuphela abanokuhlela.
r-add-actinguser-member: Yongeza umsebenzisi owaqalisa lo myalelo njengelungu
r-blocks-conflict: Lo mthetho utshintshile ngoxa ubuhlela. Layisha kwakhona umthetho ogciniweyo ngaphambi kokugcina.
r-blocks-help: Qhagamshela isiqalisi esinye kwisenzo esinye. Tsala iibhloko kwibhokisi yezixhobo. Sebenzisa umhleli wefomu ukuze ufumane iinketho eziphambili.
r-blocks-invalid: Qhagamshela isiqalisi esinye kuphela kwisenzo esinye. Susa iibhloko ezingaqhagamshelwanga okanye ezongezelelweyo ngaphambi kokugcina.
r-blocks-permission: Kufuneka imvume yomphathi webhodi ukuze kuhlelwe imithetho.
r-blocks-unavailable: Idatha yomthetho ayifumaneki. Sebenzisa umhleli wefomu ukuhlola lo mthetho.
r-cron-invalid: Icwangciso le-cron linemihlathi emihlanu: umzuzu iyure usuku inyanga usuku lweveki.
r-email-members-hint: Ilungu lebhodi elongezwe kuluhlu liya ku-To njenge-@username kwaye lithunyelwa kwidilesi ye-imeyile yelo lungu. Ezinye iidilesi ze-imeyile zisenokuchwetheza ku-To.
r-import-paste: Ncamathelisa imithetho ekhutshelweyo (JSON okanye CSV) okanye imiyalelo ye-Trello Butler apha
r-import-trello: Ngenisa imithetho evela kwi-Trello Butler (umzamo ongcono)
r-import-trello-note: Ukukhutshwa kweebhodi ze-Trello akuqulathi imithetho ye-Butler. Ncamathelisa umbhalo womyalelo we-Butler apha ukudibanisa isethi engaphantsi exhaswayo; imigca engadibananga iyaxelwa.
r-import-workflow-note: Ngenisa i-workflow ebonakalayo ekhutshelwe kwi-n8n okanye i-Node-RED. Ii-nodes ze-trigger/action eziqondwayo zidityaniswa nemithetho ye-WeKan; ii-nodes ezingadibananga ziyaxelwa.
r-import-wrike-workflow-done: Inkqubo yomsebenzi yeWrike "__name__": kongezwe izintlu __lists__ nemithetho __rules__, iindawo __skipped__ azifundwanga
r-insert-variable: Faka okuguquguqukayo kwindawo yombhalo oyikhethe mva nje:
r-rules-not-shown: Ngabalawuli bebhodi kuphela ababona iMigaqo yale bhodi.
r-trigger-vars-hint: Iindawo zoluhlu, umzila, isihloko, uluhlu lokukhangela nomsebenzisi zikwamkela i-{creator}, {assignees}, {members} kunye ne-{customField:Name}, ezifundwa ekhadini xa kuhlolwa umgaqo.
r-vars-people-hint: Kwakhona: {creator}, {assignees}, {members} (amagama abasebenzisi kumbhalo, iidilesi ze-imeyile kwindawo ethi Iya ku) kunye ne-{customField:Field name}. Ezi zikwasebenza kumagama amalungu, izintlu nemizila yezinye izenzo.
r-w-set-received-now: Misela umhla wokufunyanwa ukuba ube ngoku
r-when-a-card-title-or-description-conta: Xa isihloko okanye inkcazelo yekhadi iqulethe
r-workflow-help: Tsala i-trigger kunye nesenzo ukungenisa kwisakhi, emva koko wongeze umthetho. Tsala isenzo phezu komthetho okhoyo ukutshintsha oko akwenzayo.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Inkqubo yomsebenzi yeWrike luluhlu lwezimo, ngasinye sikwiqela le-Active, Completed, Deferred okanye Cancelled. Ukuthumela ngaphandle kubhala izintlu zale bhodi njengenkqubo enye, enegama lebhodi, kwi-JSON ebuyiswa yi-API yeWrike yeenkqubo zomsebenzi: yenza loo nkqubo kwiWrike ngaphambi kokungenisa i-Excel yeWrike yale bhodi ukuze izimo zayo zisetyenziswe. Ukungenisa kufunda loo JSON icolwe ngasentla, evela kwiWeKan okanye kwi-GET /workflows yeWrike, kuyifake kwibhodi ekhethiweyo: isimo esingenaluhlu siba luluhlu, kwaye umthetho uphawula ikhadi njengeligqityiweyo xa lisiwa kwisimo se-Completed okanye Cancelled, nanjengelingagqitywanga kwi-Active okanye Deferred. Imithetho yeWrike yokuzisebenzela ayinakuthunyelwa ngaphandle kwiWrike.
recovery-no-events: Akukho ziganeko zokubuyisela zibhaliweyo. Isiseko sedatha siphilile.
recovery-report-desc: Izenzo ezizenzekelayo zokhuseleko nokulungisa idatha: ukufumanisa umonakalo, ukugcinwa kwedatha yombhalo, ukubuyisela, ukufuduka kwakhona kwi-MongoDB, kunye nokulungiswa okuzenzekelayo kwesiseko sedatha esidumbileyo.
restore-all-skipped-wip-limit: Amakhadi angama-__count__ akabuyiselwanga: uluhlu lwawo lufikile kwimida yalo ye-WIP. Wabuyisele elinye emva kwelinye ukuze ukhethe olunye uluhlu.
restore-card-no-list-with-room: Lonke uluhlu kule bhodi lufikile kumda walo we-WIP. Phakamisa umda, okanye uhambise okanye ugcine amakhadi, ukuze ubuyisele eli khadi.
restore-card-wip-limit-reached: Uluhlu __list__ lufikile kumda walo we-WIP. Buyisela ikhadi kolunye uluhlu:
scrum-backlog-help: Cwangcisa umsebenzi ngokwenqanaba lomsebenzi osalindileyo. Yabela amakhadi kwi-sprint ecwangcisiweyo okanye esebenzayo.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Rhoxisa le sprint? Amakhadi ayo ahlala eyinxalenye yayo ade abelwe kwenye indawo.
scrum-confirm-close: Vala le sprint uze ugcine iziphumo zayo? Amakhadi angagqitywanga aya kuhanjiswa kwindawo ekhethiweyo.
scrum-daily-empty: Akukho kuqatshelweyo kwemihla ngemihla kurekhodiweyo kule sprint.
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Okuqatshelwe kuqala kwaza kwarekhodwa ngosuku ngalunye lwe-UTC; iintsuku ezingekhoyo azifakwa. Okuqatshelweyo akurekhodi lonke utshintsho okanye amanani okuphela kosuku. Uqikelelo olungaziwayo alunguziro.
scrum-daily-observations-help: Ibha nganye ibonisa okuqatshelwe kuqala kwaza kwarekhodwa ngosuku lwe-UTC, ngexesha elibonisiweyo. Iintsuku ezingekhoyo azifakwa. Oku kuqatshelweyo akurekhodi lonke utshintsho okanye kubonise amanani okuphela kosuku. Uqikelelo olungaziwayo alunguziro. Sebenzisa isenzo sokuthumela ngaphandle seli candelo ukufumana okuqatshelwe yonke imihla; isenzo sokuthumela ngaphandle kwibha yezixhobo sithumela iziphumo ze-sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Kuboniswa kuphela okuqatshelweyo kwamva nje okungu-366.
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umlawuli webhodi angabuyisela kwimeko yangaphambili okanye agcine ibhodi injengoko injalo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Utshintsho oluyi-__applied__ koluyi-__total__ lubhaliwe, oluyi-__pending__ alubhalwanga, kwaye oluyi-__conflicted__ lutshintshwe ngomnye umntu ukususela ngoko.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Ugcina yonke ingxelo injengoko injalo ngoku, kuquka utshintsho esele lubhaliwe yinkqubo emileyo?
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ukubuyisela kubeka ingxelo nganye etshintshiweyo kwimeko yayo yangaphambili; kufumaneka kuphela xa kungekho mntu wumbi utshintshe ezo ngxelo ukususela ngoko. Ukugcina ibhodi injengoko injalo kususa inkqubo emileyo kwaye akutshintshi zingxelo. Nokuba ukhetha yiphi, ibhalwa kwiPhaneli yoLawulo, Iingxaki, Ukubuyisela.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ukuhlehlisa, ukuphinda okanye ukubuyisela utshintsho lwe-Scrum kume ngenxa yongquzulwano. Ukuhlela i-Scrum kule bhodi kuthintelwe de lusonjululwe.
scrum-history-job-failed: Ukurhoxisa okanye ukwenza kwakhona utshintsho olukhulu kumile. Cofa kwakhona ku-rhoxisa okanye ku-yenza kwakhona ukuze uqhubeke:
scrum-history-job-running: Kurhoxiswa okanye kwenziwa kwakhona utshintsho olukhulu: __done__ kwimigca yembali engama-__total__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikhadi lihambelana namakhadi angaphezu kwelinye kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikhadi lelenye ibhodi kwaye lishiywe lingatshintshwanga: __reference__
scrum-import-into-board-done: Ucwangciso lwe-Scrum lungenisiwe lwaza lwarekhodwa kwiMbali.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Khetha ifayile yebhodi ekhutshwe kwi-WeKan okanye ifayile yokudlulisa i-Scrum. Ii-sprint nokukhutshwa esele kukho kule bhodi kuyaqhagamshelwa, akuphindwa. Amakhadi athelekiswa nge-ID, okanye ngenombolo yekhadi nesihloko; amakhadi angahambelaniyo adweliswa aze ashiywe engatshintshwanga. Jonga kuqala ukuze ubone okuza kutshintsha.
scrum-import-pending: Ukungeniswa kwe-Scrum akugqitywanga. Ukuhlelwa kwe-Scrum nokuthunyelwa kweengxelo ngaphandle akufumaneki.
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Akukho nto iza kutshintshwa: le bhodi sele inolu cwangciso.
scrum-import-preview-releases: Ukukhutshwa: __created__ okutsha, __matched__ okusele kukule bhodi, __skipped__ okungangeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ii-sprint: __created__ ezintsha, __matched__ esele zikule bhodi, __skipped__ ezingangeniswanga
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: I-sprint okanye ukukhutshwa kuhambelana nokungaphezu kokunye kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: I-sprint, ukukhutshwa okanye isiganeko asikwazanga ukungeniswa: __reference__
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Ukungenisa okuphazanyiswe kukuqala ngokutsha kungagqityezelwa apha emva kokuba kumile. Ukuba isicwangciso sako asizange sigcinwe siphelele, kunokurhoxiswa kuphela; oku akutshintshi nto ebhodini.
scrum-partial-report: Ingxelo engaphelelanga: kufakwe kuphela amakhadi owabelweyo ngoku.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Le sprint iqulethe kuphela inxalenye yomfanekiso wokuqala ogciniweyo.
scrum-releases-select-help: Ikhadi linokuba kukhupho oluninzi. Bamba u-Ctrl (u-Cmd kwi-Mac) ukuze ukhethe ngaphezu kwesinye; susa konke okukhethiweyo ukuze ususe ikhadi kulo lonke ukhupho.
scrum-report-help: Iingxelo zigcina uqikelelo oluvela kwimifanekiso egciniweyo yee-sprint. Uqikelelo olungaziwayo lubalwa ngokwahlukeneyo; asilulo uqikelelo olunguziro. Thelekisa isantya somsebenzi kuphela xa iiyunithi zoqikelelo nemigaqo zifana.
scrum-rollover-progress: Kuhanjiswa amakhadi e-sprint ukuya phambili: __done__ kwangama-__total__
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Ikhadi ligcinwe kwindawo yogcino okanye libuyiselwe
scrum-scope-history: Ubungakanani bomsebenzi nomsebenzi oseleyo, utshintsho ngalunye
scrum-scope-history-empty: Akukho tshintsho ukususela ekuqaleni kwexesha lomsebenzi.
scrum-scope-history-help: Kwakhiwe ngokutsha kwimbali yebhodi ukususela ekuqaleni kwexesha lomsebenzi: umqolo omnye wotshintsho ngalunye kumakhadi exesha lomsebenzi, kuqikelelo okanye kumsebenzi ogqityiweyo.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Imbali ayiphindi ivelise umfanekiso wemeko yeli xesha lomsebenzi ngokwalo: olunye utshintsho lwenziwa lungabhalwanga kwimbali, ngoko la maxabiso akaphelelanga.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Kufundeke kuphela utshintsho lokuqala; ukwakhiwa ngokutsha akuphelelanga.
scrum-select-sprint: Khetha i-sprint ukuze ubone ingxelo yayo.
submit-on-enter-description: Xa ivuliwe, ukucofa u-Enter kugcina isihloko sekhadi, inkcazo kunye nabanye abahleli abangaphakathi; Shift+Enter ifaka umgca omtsha. Xa icimile, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter iyagcina kwaye u-Enter ufaka umgca omtsha.
subtask-done-no-permission: Awunako ukutshintsha ukuba lo msebenzi ungaphantsi ugqityiwe na
text-contains-trigger-description: Iyahambelana xa kudalwa ikhadi, okanye isihloko okanye inkcazelo yalo itshintshiwe, umbhalo omtsha uqulethe oku (akukho mahluko phakathi konobumba abakhulu nabancinci).
title: Isihloko
tracking-info: Uya kwaziswa ngalo naluphi na utshintsho kuloo makhadi ubandakanyekayo njengomdali okanye ilungu.
watching-info: Uya kwaziswa ngalo naluphi na utshintsho kule bhodi
webhook-hide-identity: Shiya igama lam ngaphandle kwii-webhook eziphumayo
webhook-payload-description: Izinto ezithunyelwa zii-webhook eziphumayo (Rocket.Chat, Slack, ...). Ukhetho olumiselweyo lugcina useto oluzuzwe kwelinye inqanaba; xa kungekho nto isetiweyo, ii-webhook zithumela oko bezisoloko zikuthumela.
webhook-payload-field-people: Ilungu okanye umntu owabelweyo ekuthethwa ngaye
